WITH fy AS (
  SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
),
fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT (SELECT d0 FROM fy) d0, (SELECT d1 FROM fy) d1,
  COUNT(*) AS first_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN (SELECT d0 FROM fy) AND (SELECT d1 FROM fy) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_fy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date <> valid_from THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS join_ne_validfrom,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_join,
  MAX(join_date) AS max_join
FROM fv WHERE vn = 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.close_date, cs.open_date, COUNT(*) AS new_members,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs.store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched
FROM fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.vn = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, MIN(join_date) mn, MAX(join_date) mx, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) after_close
FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND home_store_id IN (129, 900, 136, 137, 999, 104, 119)
 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
